messages.subject: [Tikzdevice-bugs] CRAN package warnings
messages.body_plain:
The CRAN package checks at
http://cran.r-project.org/web/checks/check_summary.html have for some
months been showing warnings of the form

* checking loading without being on the library search path ... WARNING

for packages

GOSim RLadyBug UScensus2000 UScensus2010 VIM accuracy svKomodo tikzDevice

This indicates an error in your startup code, which needs to work even
if your package is attached by library("foo", lib.loc="bar"): most often
libname has not been passed on in .onLoad or .onAttach.

Please fix by July 9, or the package will be archived on CRAN.  (There
may be other issues shown on those pages which need to be addressed.)

--
